methods.label: Use the Pythagorean theorem
methods.explanation: A diagonal divides the square into 2 isosceles right triangles. By the Pythagorean theorem, the diagonal length is \(\sqrt{2^2+2^2}=2\sqrt{2}\).
methods.levelReason: The method uses elementary square properties and Grade 8 Pythagorean and radical calculations.
